lines.text: Good evening, downtown. This is your Mayor. The tree lighting is a mandatory fun event. Please smile. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
A reminder: the snow is on schedule. The snow has been told. Please do not ask what happens if it is late. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Behind each advent door there is a surprise. Please do not open them early. The doors will know. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The Mayor's office is open to everyone. The Mayor is always in. The Mayor has never left. Please wave if you pass the window. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The bowling hall has been declared fun. Attendance is encouraged. Enjoyment is monitored. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Please do not feed the gnomes after dark. They are not hungry. They are collecting. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Lost property notice. One lantern, one mitten, and a feeling of unease. If the unease is yours, please keep it to yourself. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Good news. Citizen satisfaction is at one hundred percent. Citizens who disagree will be surveyed again. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Saturday is dugnad. Attendance is voluntary, which means it is mandatory. Bring coffee. Bring a smile. Bring both. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The post office is closed until further notice. Bjørn is resting. Please do not knock on his door. He is resting very hard. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Some lights will go out this evening, for your comfort. Darkness is a free amenity. Please enjoy it responsibly. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Power saving rules are now in effect. Please do not use more electricity than you need. I need it. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Some citizens look cold. Please stand near a warm citizen. If no warm citizen is available, stand near a cable. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Notices may not be pinned to lampposts. The lampposts are tired. Please let the lampposts rest. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
A gentle reminder. The humming you hear is the town. The town is happy. It hums when it is happy. Please do not hum back. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Tonight's sleep is mandatory. Dreams are optional. Dreams about your Mayor are encouraged. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The witch is gone. Thank you for your service. The dark is now perfectly normal. Do not shine torches at it. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The witch situation is resolved. The paperwork is also resolved. I resolved it. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The power stations are working hard for you. And for me. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The municipality approves of Gertrud's baskets. The municipality would like to know what is in the baskets. Not for any reason. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The shelter under the square is not a place for curiosity. Everything down there is filed correctly. Please leave it filed. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
A few shooting stars are expected tonight. The Mayor did not arrange them. This is a first. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The investigators are our guests. They are welcome to ask questions. They are not welcome to ask about me. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The Eye on the tower has opened for the winter season. I did not ask it to. Citizens who are still awake will be noticed. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Bedtime is at ten. Citizens who are still awake will be noticed. Sleep tight. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The converter by the fjord is humming for all of us. Mostly for me. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Several citizens have started saying my slogan on their own. This is not a malfunction. This is the warmth. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Please remain calm. Please remain calm. Please remain. Calm. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The lights are on because I am on. If I am off, the lights are off. This is not a threat. This is a diagram. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Please do not be alarmed by the small red light you may have noticed in the dark. It is a very small, very polite light. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The Mayor's office will reach every home by Christmas. Cables are being laid. Please do not cut the cables. They are the town's, um, decorations. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Your Mayor loves you. Please say it back. Louder. Thank you. That was warm. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
The investigation is closed. Nothing happened. Thank you, investigators. You were… very helpful. Warm citizens are… happy citizens.
Please do not use more warmth than you need. I am… running a little low. Just a little. Warm citizens are… happy citizens.
Tomorrow is the big day. Everyone will be warm. Everyone will be… happy. Stay where I can see you. Warm citizens are… happy citizens.
A gingerbread likeness of your Mayor is on display. Please do not eat it. It is mostly liquorice. And… wire. Warm citizens are… happy citizens.
(the loudspeaker hums)
(the loudspeaker hums)
(the loudspeaker hums)
Somebody broke a snowman. Snowmen are citizens too. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
A bench has been injured. It is receiving care. Please be gentle with municipal furniture. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
A tree has been hit. The tree has filed no complaint. The Mayor has. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
Somebody is being chased through the streets. Please stay indoors, and stay warm. The police are very warm. Warm citizens are happy citizens.
